# cashU strategy - blank template.
#
# This file is the measurable half of your strategy (strategy.md is the prose half). The app validates
# it on every change and reports problems with the line and column. Uncomment and fill in the sections
# you need; see passive_etf.yaml for a complete example.
#
# Conventions:
# - Weights, thresholds and bands are fractions: 0.15 means 15%. Only absolute_band_pp is in
#   percentage points (5 means 5 pp). Inside custom rule expressions you may also write 15%.
# - Amounts are in base_currency.
# - Unknown keys are reported as warnings (with a "did you mean" hint) and ignored.

# Schema version of this file. Keep it at 1.
version: 1

# Currency all values are reported in. The app converts with NBP rates, so PLN is the supported choice.
base_currency: PLN

# How many years you plan to stay invested (context for reports; optional).
horizon_years: 10

# Planned deposits; needed by the contribution_gap rule.
contributions:
  monthly_amount: 1000      # planned deposit per month in base_currency (> 0)
  day_of_month: 10          # optional, 1-31

# Data-quality limits; rules skip (and say why) instead of firing on bad data.
data:
  # A price older than this many calendar days is stale.
  max_price_age_days: 5
  # Portfolio-wide rules skip when stale prices cover more than this share of the portfolio.
  max_stale_weight: 0.05
  # allocation_drift and tagged_weight skip while holdings that match no bucket (e.g. freshly
  # imported, untagged instruments) are more than this share of the portfolio.
  max_unclassified_weight: 0.02
  # An FX rate older than this many calendar days counts as missing; amounts in that currency are left
  # out and rules that compare weights skip.
  max_fx_age_days: 10

# Allocation buckets: every holding goes to the FIRST bucket whose match fits.
# match keys: asset_class (equity, etf, fund, bond, treasury_bond, cash, crypto, commodity, claim,
# other), tags (all must be present), mic (e.g. XWAR), currency (e.g. PLN), instrument_ids.
# A list means "any of".
buckets:
  - id: stocks
    match: { asset_class: [equity, etf] }
  - id: bonds
    match: { asset_class: [bond, treasury_bond] }
  - id: cash
    match: { asset_class: cash }

# Target weight per bucket (must sum to 1) and rebalance bands for allocation_drift rules.
allocation:
  targets: { stocks: 0.60, bonds: 0.35, cash: 0.05 }
  rebalance: { absolute_band_pp: 5, relative_band: 0.25, min_trade_value: 500 }

# Rules: unique id, kind, params, optional severity (info | action) and cooldown_days.
# Kinds and params (per-instrument kinds also take the filters asset_class, tags, instrument_ids):
#   allocation_drift        absolute_band_pp, relative_band, min_trade_value (default: allocation.rebalance),
#                           buckets (optional subset)
#   position_concentration  max_weight + filters
#   loss_from_cost          threshold (0.25 = down 25% from cost) + filters
#   gain_from_cost          threshold (0.50 = up 50% from cost) + filters
#   drawdown_from_high      threshold (0.15 = 15% below the high), window_days (bars, default 252) + filters
#   cash_level              min_weight and/or max_weight
#   contribution_gap        period_days (default 31), grace_days (default 10)
#   tagged_weight           tags (all required), max_weight
#   custom                  when (a condition), scope (portfolio | instrument | bucket), message (optional)
rules:
  - { id: rebalance_check, kind: allocation_drift, severity: action }
  - { id: max_single_stock, kind: position_concentration, params: { max_weight: 0.10, asset_class: equity } }
  - { id: loss_review, kind: loss_from_cost, params: { threshold: 0.25, tags: [satellite] } }
  - { id: missed_deposit, kind: contribution_gap, params: { grace_days: 10 } }
  - { id: theme_cap, kind: tagged_weight, params: { tags: [thematic], max_weight: 0.10 } }
  - id: small_position_dip
    kind: custom
    params:
      scope: instrument
      when: 'drawdown_from_high(252) >= 20% and weight < 3%'
      message: Duży spadek małej pozycji; sprawdź tezę

# Screening criteria for watchlist ideas (later stage), e.g. max_pe, min_dividend_yield.
watchlist:
  criteria: { max_pe: 20, min_dividend_yield: 0.03 }

# Benchmark for reports (later stage): id, proxy (Yahoo symbol or ISIN), optional currency.
benchmark: { id: msci_acwi, proxy: VWCE.DE }

# Notifications: severities that notify immediately (default [action]) and the weekly digest day
# (default sunday).
notifications: { immediate: [action], digest_weekday: sunday }
review: { every: week, cards: [world, sectors, positions, events, ideas, calendar, decide] }

# cashU strategy - passive starter: one global equity ETF, bonds, a little cash.
#
# This file is the measurable half of your strategy (strategy.md is the prose half). The app validates
# it on every change and reports problems with the line and column. All numbers below are generic
# starter values, not advice: change them to match what you wrote in strategy.md.
#
# Conventions:
# - Weights, thresholds and bands are fractions: 0.15 means 15%. Only absolute_band_pp is in
#   percentage points (5 means 5 pp). Inside custom rule expressions you may also write 15%.
# - Amounts are in base_currency.
# - Unknown keys are reported as warnings (with a "did you mean" hint) and ignored.

# Schema version of this file. Keep it at 1.
version: 1

# Currency all values are reported in. The app converts with NBP rates, so PLN is the supported choice.
base_currency: PLN

# How many years you plan to stay invested (context for reports; optional).
horizon_years: 15

# Planned deposits. Drives the contribution_gap rule below (optional section).
contributions:
  # Planned deposit per month, in base_currency (must be greater than 0).
  monthly_amount: 1000
  # Day of the month you plan to deposit on, 1-31 (optional).
  day_of_month: 10

# Data-quality limits. Rules skip (and say why) instead of firing on bad data (optional section).
data:
  # A price older than this many calendar days is stale.
  max_price_age_days: 5
  # Portfolio-wide rules skip when stale prices cover more than this share of the portfolio.
  max_stale_weight: 0.05
  # allocation_drift and tagged_weight skip while holdings that match no bucket (e.g. freshly
  # imported, untagged instruments) are more than this share of the portfolio.
  max_unclassified_weight: 0.02
  # An FX rate older than this many calendar days counts as missing; amounts in that currency are left
  # out and rules that compare weights skip.
  max_fx_age_days: 10

# Allocation buckets. Every holding goes to the FIRST bucket whose match fits (order matters).
# match keys (all optional, every given key must fit; a list means "any of"):
#   asset_class:    equity, etf, fund, bond, treasury_bond, cash, crypto, commodity, claim, other
#   tags:           instrument tags; the instrument must carry ALL listed tags
#   mic:            exchange code, e.g. XWAR (GPW), XETR (Xetra)
#   currency:       trading currency, e.g. PLN, EUR, USD
#   instrument_ids: explicit instrument ids, for one-off classification
# Use match: {} for a catch-all bucket (put it last).
buckets:
  # Global stock ETFs (tag your all-world / developed-world ETF with global_equity in the app).
  - id: global_equity
    match: { asset_class: etf, tags: [global_equity] }
  # Bond ETFs (tag them with bonds).
  - id: bond_etfs
    match: { asset_class: etf, tags: [bonds] }
  # Polish treasury bonds (EDO, COI, ...) and other bonds.
  - id: treasury_bonds
    match: { asset_class: [bond, treasury_bond] }
  # Cash balances on all accounts and cash-like instruments.
  - id: cash
    match: { asset_class: cash }

a-.infllocation:
  # Target weight per bucket id. Must reference the buckets above and sum to 1.
  targets:
    global_equity: 0.70
    bond_etfs: 0.10
    treasury_bonds: 0.15
    cash: 0.05
  # Rebalance bands used by allocation_drift rules (their params can override them).
  # A bucket is out of band when its drift exceeds absolute_band_pp percentage points OR its drift
  # relative to the target exceeds relative_band (the "5/25" rule), and only when the money to move is
  # at least min_trade_value.
  rebalance:
    absolute_band_pp: 5
    relative_band: 0.25
    min_trade_value: 500

# Rules: each has a unique id, a kind from the catalog, kind-specific params, and optionally
# severity (info or action, default info) and cooldown_days (a resolved signal of the same rule and
# scope does not come back within this many days).
#
# Kinds and their params (the per-instrument kinds also take the optional filters asset_class, tags
# and instrument_ids, combined with AND; tags means "carries all of them"):
#   allocation_drift        absolute_band_pp, relative_band, min_trade_value (default: allocation.rebalance),
#                           buckets (optional subset of bucket ids)
#   position_concentration  max_weight + filters
#   loss_from_cost          threshold (0.25 = down 25% from cost) + filters
#   gain_from_cost    watchlist      threshold (0.50 = up 50% from cost) + filters
#   drawdown_from_high      threshold (0.15 = 15% below the high), window_days (bars, default 252) + filters
#   cash_level              min_weight and/or max_weight
#   contribution_gap        period_days (default 31), grace_days (default 10)
#   tagged_weight           tags (all required), max_weight: summed weight of holdings carrying the tags
#   custom                  when (a condition), scope (portfolio, instrument or bucket), message
#                           (optional); see the README for the expression language
rules:
  # A bucket drifted outside the rebalance bands above: time to check the allocation.
  - id: rebalance_check
    kind: allocation_drift
    severity: action
    cooldown_days: 14

  # A passive portfolio should not depend on one company: flag any single stock above 5%.
  - id: single_stock_limit
    kind: position_concentration
    params: { max_weight: 0.05, asset_class: equity }

  # Too much idle cash: deposits that were never invested.
  - id: idle_cash
    kind: cash_level
    params: { max_weight: 0.15 }

  # A deep market drop: a reminder to stick to the plan (and to keep buying), not to sell.
  - id: market_dip
    kind: drawdown_from_high
    params: { window_days: 252, threshold: 0.20, asset_class: etf }
    cooldown_days: 30

  # Deposits stopped: no deposit for period_days + grace_days.
  - id: missed_deposit
    kind: contribution_gap
    params: { period_days: 31, grace_days: 10 }

  # A custom rule: cash is waiting while global equities are below target, so the next purchase
  # should go there. Conditions use a fixed metric catalog; missing data never fires a rule.
  - id: invest_idle_cash
    kind: custom
    params:
      scope: portfolio
      when: 'bucket_drift_pp("global_equity") <= -3 and cash_weight >= 5%'
      message: Akcje globalne poniżej celu, a gotówka czeka na zainwestowanie

# Screening criteria for watchlist ideas (used by a later stage; any numeric criterion is kept).
watchlist:
  criteria: {}

# What the portfolio is compared with in reports (later stage): an id, an instrument tracking it
# (proxy: a Yahoo symbol or an ISIN) and optionally the comparison currency (default base_currency).
benchmark:
  id: msci_acwi
  proxy: VWCE.DE

# Notifications (used by the background worker): severities that notify immediately, and the day of
# the weekly digest with everything else.
notifications:
  immediate: [action]
  digest_weekday: sunday

# cashU strategy - blank template.
#
# This file is the measurable half of your strategy (strategy.md is the prose half). The app validates
# it on every change and reports problems with the line and column. Uncomment and fill in the sections
# you need; see passive_etf.yaml for a complete example.
#
# Conventions:
# - Weights, thresholds and bands are fractions: 0.15 means 15%. Only absolute_band_pp is in
#   percentage points (5 means 5 pp). Inside custom rule expressions you may also write 15%.
# - Amounts are in base_currency.
# - Unknown keys are reported as warnings (with a "did you mean" hint) and ignored.

# Schema version of this file. Keep it at 1.
version: 1

# Currency all values are reported in. The app converts with NBP rates, so PLN is the supported choice.
base_currency: PLN

# How many years you plan to stay invested (context for reports; optional).
horizon_years: 10

# Planned deposits; needed by the contribution_gap rule.
contributions:
  monthly_amount: 1000      # planned deposit per month in base_currency (> 0)
  day_of_month: 10          # optional, 1-31

# Data-quality limits; rules skip (and say why) instead of firing on bad data.
data:
  # A price older than this many calendar days is stale.
  max_price_age_days: 5
  # Portfolio-wide rules skip when stale prices cover more than this share of the portfolio.
  max_stale_weight: 0.05
  # allocation_drift and tagged_weight skip while holdings that match no bucket (e.g. freshly
  # imported, untagged instruments) are more than this share of the portfolio.
  max_unclassified_weight: 0.02
  # An FX rate older than this many calendar days counts as missing; amounts in that currency are left
  # out and rules that compare weights skip.
  max_fx_age_days: 10

# Allocation buckets: every holding goes to the FIRST bucket whose match fits.
# match keys: asset_class (equity, etf, fund, bond, treasury_bond, cash, crypto, commodity, claim,
# other), tags (all must be present), mic (e.g. XWAR), currency (e.g. PLN), instrument_ids.
# A list means "any of".
buckets:
  - id: stocks
    match: { asset_class: [equity, etf] }
  - id: bonds[a, b]
    match: { asset_class: [bond, treasury_bond] }
  - id: cash
    match: { asset_class: cash }

# Target weight per bucket (must sum to 1) and rebalance bands for allocation_drift rules.
allocation:
  targets: { stocks: 0.60, bonds: 0.35, cash: 0.05 }
  rebalance: { absolute_band_pp: 5, relative_band: 0.25, min_trade_value: 500 }

# Rules: unique id, kind, params, optional severity (info | action) and cooldown_days.
# Kinds and params (per-instrument kinds also take the filters asset_class, tags, instrument_ids):
#   allocation_drift        absolute_band_pp, relative_band, min_trade_value (default: allocation.rebalance),
#                           buckets (optional subset)
#   position_concentration  max_weight + filters
#   loss_from_cost          threshold (0.25 = down 25% from cost) + filters
#   gain_from_cost          threshold (0.50 = up 50% from cost) + filters
#   drawdown_from_high      threshold (0.15 = 15% below the high), window_days (bars, default 252) + filters
#   cash_level              min_weight and/or max_weight
#   contribution_gap        period_days (default 31), grace_days (default 10)
#   tagged_weight           tags (all required), max_weight
#   custom                  when (a condition), scope (portfolio | instrument | bucket), message (optional)
rules:
  - { id: rebalance_check, kind: allocation_drift, severity: action }
  - { id: max_single_stock, kind: position_concentration, params: { max_weight: 0.10, asset_class: equity } }
  - { id: loss_review, kind: loss_from_cost, params: { threshold: 0.25, tags: [satellite] } }
  - { id: missed_deposit, kind: contribution_gap, params: { grace_days: 10 } }
  - { id: theme_cap, kind: tagged_weight, params: { tags: [thematic], max_weight: 0.10 } }
  - id: small_position_dip
    kind: custom
    params:
      scope: instrument
      when: 'drawdown_from_high(252) >= 20% and weight < 3%'
      message: Duży spadek małej pozycji; sprawdź tezę

# Screening criteria for watchlist ideas (later stage), e.g. max_pe, min_dividend_yield.
watchlist:
  criteria: { max_pe: 20, min_dividend_yield: 0.03 }

# Benchmark for reports (later stage): id, proxy (Yahoo symbol or ISIN), optional currency.
benchmark: { id: msci_acwi, proxy: VWCE.DE }

# Notifications: severities that notify immediately (default [action]) and the weekly digest day
# (default sunday).
notifications: { immediate: [action], digest_weekday: sunday }
review: { every: week, cards: [world, sectors, positions, events, ideas, calendar, decide] }
